requirement: Native client-owned booking requests only, through the registered existing lifecycle APIs. Host binds service, time zone, optional request and independent confirmation. Requests are not confirmed appointments.

create.name: primecare_client_booking_request_create
create.description: After independent confirmation, save a pending request for the host-selected service and the caller's preferred local date/time. This does not reserve availability or confirm an appointment.

status.name: primecare_client_booking_request_status
status.description: Read the status of the existing host-bound client-owned booking request. Does not read another account or confirm a service appointment.

cancel.name: primecare_client_booking_request_cancel
cancel.description: After independent confirmation, cancel only the existing host-bound pending booking request. This does not cancel an actual service appointment.
